Short version of the Ames housing data

Source: R/OBJECT_ames_de_test.R
ames_de_test.Rd

This is a shortened version of the Ames housing data, test set

Usage

data("ames_de_test")

Format

A data frame containing 500 rows and 11 columns

id

id

preis

price

wohflaeche

size

grundstuecksflaeche

lot size

badezimmer

number of bath rooms

schlafzimmer

number of rooms

baujahr

year built

garage

car garage included?

kamin

Fireplace included?

umbau

Has the house been renovated?

pool

Swimming pool included

Source

Please cite this dataset as: 'De Cock, D. 2011. “Ames, Iowa: Alternative to the Boston Housing Data as an End of Semester Regression Project.” Journal of Statistics Education 19 (3).'

Details

A codebook can be found here: https://support.minitab.com/en-us/datasets/predictive-analytics-data-sets/ames-housing-data/ or here: http://jse.amstat.org/v19n3/decock/DataDocumentation.txt.
